title: pterocaulon alopecuroides
intro: Pterocaulon alopecuroides, commonly known as "Cotton-Top", is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Compositae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pterocaulon alopecuroides include wound healing, skin soothing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
